## Level-Up Flow

**When offered:** Worker computes `shouldLevelUp(character)` (`worker/src/services/character.ts:159`) = `xp >= XP_THRESHOLDS[level]` (0, 300, 900, 2700, 6500, 14000, 23000, 34000, 48000, 64000) and `level < 10`. Returned as `canLevelUp` from `POST /api/action` and `POST /api/combat/resolve`. Frontend pre-computes it too (`character-state.service.ts` `checkLevelUp`) but the server value always overwrites it (`game-console.component.ts:128,155`). UI shows a banner on the character sheet (`character-sheet.component.html:66`) and an ability-choice picker in the console sidebar (`game-console.component.html:19-28`); a system message nudges the player after combat.

**Endpoint called:** Clicking an ability key calls `GameApiService.levelUp(sessionId, characterId, abilityChoice)` (`game-api.service.ts:74`), hitting `POST /api/levelup` (`worker/src/routes/levelup.ts:10`). `abilityChoice` must be one of str/dex/con/int/wis/cha; returns 400 if `!shouldLevelUp`.

**What changes (`services/character.ts:133` `levelUp`):**
- `level` += 1
- HP gain = roll(class hit die) + CON modifier, added to both `max_hp` and current HP (hit dice: Fighter/Ranger d10, Rogue/Cleric/Bard d8, Wizard d6)
- Chosen ability score += 2 (AC unchanged; scores aren't capped at 20 — B-03 note)

Route then generates flavor text (usually fallback), writes a `[Level Up]` system log row and a DM history turn, and the frontend updates the character, sets `canLevelUp` false, shows a system message, and bumps the campaign slot level. One level per call — a double-level-up needs two calls.
